description: This Java source file defines the FrameworkResourceLoader class, which loads Android framework resources, including handling locale-specific resource filtering and resource initialization.

classes.name: FrameworkResourceLoader
classes.description: Main class responsible for loading Android framework resources, managing locale requests, and initializing resource data.

classes.name: IdeFrameworkResources
classes.description: Inner class extending FrameworkResources, managing resource initialization, locale skipping, and resource folder processing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads framework resources for a given Android target, returning FrameworkResources or null if the resource directory is invalid.

methods.name: loadPlatformResources
methods.description: Helper method to load resources from a specified folder with logging.

methods.name: requestLocales
methods.description: Sets whether locale-specific resources should be loaded.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the resource cache in IdeFrameworkResources.

methods.name: getSkippedLocales
methods.description: Returns whether locale folders are skipped during resource loading.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources if not already initialized, filtering locale folders if needed.
